registerPolicy: вы in every interlocutor and learner line across all 10 paths; no ты-forms, no youth slang, no imperatives without пожалуйста toward strangers; friends remain on вы (consistent with A1/A2); service staff use neutral polite Russian (скажите, пожалуйста / к сожалению / давайте).
genderSafety: Voice plan continues A2 by path parity: odd paths female canonical (Nina/Maria roster), even paths male (Mark/Alan); parity is read by the TTS roster script, not stored as a lesson field. Design learner turns gender-free wherever the staged goal allows (мы-narration, у меня было, мне бы хотелось, можно было бы, мне удалось + infinitive, neuter short participles, present/future). Where a beat requires speaker-agreeing forms, canonical text follows the path gender and a COMPLETE opposite-gender alternative string of the whole turn is authored (lesson.genderAlternatives) and accepted for typed and spoken input; never suffix-guessed. Gender audit is semantic, not regex: a past -л/-ла or short-form token is unsafe only when its subject is the speaker (я). Third-person forms about others (она сказала, поезд ушёл, касса закрылась), мы-forms (мы ездили — any mixed or same-gender group), neuter impersonals (сделано, стало холоднее) and nouns ending in -л/-ла (стол, школа, дела) are safe. Mechanical denylist is a closed exact-token list: хотел, хотела, рад, рада, должен, должна, привык, привыкла, готов, готова, смог, смогла, забыл, забыла, решил, решила, сам, сама. In addition each lesson's author note lists the exact reviewed speaker-agreeing tokens in dialogue[1]/[3]; expected per path: P1 L4-10 я-past (приехала/приехал, увидела/увидел, села/сел), P3 L7-10 если бы я знала/знал, P8 L1-3 ездила/ездил, ела/ел, летала/летал, P8 L7 перестала/перестал, P10 L1-3 переехала/переехал, нашла/нашёл. None of these tokens may be speakRequired, recall answer, cloze answer or trophy.
orthography: Cyrillic only; ё written wherever it belongs in all target text (ещё, всё, идёт, счёт); every accepted answer also lists the е-spelling fold; numbers as words with numeral-case review (два дня, пять минут); native punctuation (« » optional, en-dash for ranges); no digits, no Latin letters, no transliteration in target text.

segmentation.dialogue0: Interlocutor opening (dialogue[0]) 8-16 Cyrillic words, natural spoken Russian, may contain one aside; quoted verbatim in sceneCaption.de and .en.
segmentation.dialogue1: Learner first reply (dialogue[1]) 8-16 words; exactly the join of the chunks; carries the trophy; source of speakRequired tokens and the recall blank; gender-free where the staged goal allows.
segmentation.dialogue2: Interlocutor complication (dialogue[2]) 6-14 words; adds information turn 0 could not anticipate; never quoted in captions.
segmentation.dialogue3: Learner closing (dialogue[3]) 6-12 words; target of the cloze; shape A workable next step, shape B continues the mini-narrative, shape C accepts the counter-offer with one explicit change.
segmentation.chunks: 4-7 meaningful phrase chunks (discourse marker | verb phrase | object/complement | subordinate clause); chunks.join(' ') === dialogue[1].targetText byte-for-byte; no chunk ends inside a word; punctuation stays attached to the preceding chunk.
segmentation.speechTokens: Three distinct Cyrillic surface tokens from dialogue[1], ≥4 letters each, not pronouns, not да/нет, not on the speaker-agreeing denylist (see genderSafety), ё/е fold applied; optional tokens cover remaining content words.
segmentation.trophyAnchoring: Trophy is the exact surface form appearing in dialogue[1].targetText and in trophyWord.example (NFC + casefold, whole token after stripping punctuation); adverbs, conjunctions, prepositions, nominative nouns, infinitives, neuter short participles and fixed first-person forms (собираюсь) are chosen so no inflection is needed; never a substring inside another word.
segmentation.acceptedInput: Where the runtime exposes accepted answers for a learner turn, the set is: canonical + ё→е fold + the reviewed full-string opposite-gender alternative from lesson.genderAlternatives (when present) + at most one reviewed full-string word-order variant; each entry is a complete turn, never a partial string, never suffix-generated; recall and cloze accept canonical and е-fold only.

knownTraps: Aspect choice in narration: imperfective for background/duration (ждали, шёл дождь), perfective for sequenced events (пришли, увидели); distractors must not create a second valid reading.

бы never combines with a finite present or future form (*я бы иду, *я бы поеду). It combines with the past-tense form in conditional and polite-request clauses (вы не могли бы, если бы было, мне бы хотелось) and with a bare infinitive in wish/possibility frames (Можно бы поехать. Мне бы отдохнуть. Поехать бы на море!). Productive scope in this spec: бы + past form, мне бы хотелось + infinitive, можно было бы + infinitive; bare infinitive + бы (Поехать бы) is recognition-only in interlocutor lines. хотел бы / хотела бы is gendered — prefer мне бы хотелось in canonical learner lines.
который agrees in gender/number with antecedent but takes case from its own clause (сумка, которую; поезд, на котором); never calque German der/die/das.
ли attaches after the focused word (не знаете ли вы / работает ли касса); embedded question-word clauses never add ли.
Short passive participles (закрыто, сделано, оформлен/оформлена) agree with the thing, not the speaker; neuter impersonal forms are gender-safe, nominal subjects are not.
чтобы + infinitive only with same subject; different subject requires чтобы + past form.
Deictics здесь/сейчас/теперь/уже/ещё are forbidden trophies but remain free in dialogue text; do not avoid them in sentences.
раньше (formerly) vs ранее (earlier, formal); перестать + imperfective infinitive only.
Numeral case after два/три/четыре (genitive singular) vs пять+ (genitive plural) in all cost/time follow-ups.
ё/е homographs (все/всё) must be disambiguated by context in cloze and recall; never a blank that е-fold makes ambiguous.
German base must not over-formalise (Sie) into archaic Russian; English base must not shorten Russian hedges (пожалуй, впрочем) into nothing.
mechanicalValidationRules: Exactly 10 paths × 10 lessons; 100 trophies pairwise distinct and absent from forbiddenTrophies under NFC + casefold.
Trophy surface token occurs in dialogue[1].targetText and in trophyWord.example (string), tokenised on whitespace, punctuation stripped.
dialogue is exactly 4 tuples {targetText, baseText:{de,en}} all non-empty; turns 0 and 2 are the interlocutor, 1 and 3 the learner.
Word counts: dialogue[0] and dialogue[1] 8-16 Cyrillic words; dialogue[2] 6-14; dialogue[3] 6-12.
chunks: array of {targetText, baseText:{de,en}}, length 4-7; chunk targetTexts joined by a single ASCII space === dialogue[1].targetText.

speakRequired has 3 distinct tokens, each present in dialogue[1].targetText after ё/е fold, length ≥4, not a pronoun, not да/нет, not in the closed exact-token denylist in genderSafety and not in the lesson's reviewed speaker-agreeing list; no suffix regex is applied.

cloze is an array of strings and blank objects {kind, answer, cue?, choices}; concatenating strings and answers in order === dialogue[3].targetText; 2-3 blank objects per lesson drawn from the path clozeSchema as a menu (not every blank class in every lesson) and only for constructions staged at or before that lesson; choices.length === 4 with answer present exactly once; kind in form|connector|choice; cue present iff kind === 'form'; no choice is a speaker-agreeing gendered form; no answer is a bare pronoun or single-letter word.
recall.before + recall.answer + recall.after === dialogue[1].targetText; fallbackChoices.length === 4 containing answer exactly once; answer is a content word of ≥4 letters, not on the denylist.

pattern = {label:string, rule:{de,en}, examples:[{targetText, baseText:{de,en}, highlight}]}; examples.length 2-3; each highlight is a contiguous substring of its targetText; exactly one example targetText equals dialogue[1].targetText or dialogue[3].targetText.

trophyWord = {word, meaning:{de,en}, example:string, whyThisWord:{de,en}}; whyThisWord names the surface form chosen (adverb, infinitive, neuter participle) in one clause — no separate surfaceNote field.
pedagogicalGoal is a single German string; no English mirror field exists.
Every target text matches /^[А-Яа-яЁё\s.,!?;:«»()—-]+$/ (no digits, no Latin letters); words of the curated ё-lexicon (ещё, всё, идёт, счёт, её, партнёр, насчёт) always carry ё.

sceneCaption.de and .en each contain dialogue[0].targetText verbatim inside quotation marks; neither contains dialogue[2].targetText in full nor any contiguous run of 4 or more consecutive tokens of it; whether a caption hints at the complication is semantic review, not a token test.

Where accepted answers exist for a learner turn: entry 0 === targetText; every other entry equals canonical with ё→е applied, or equals the authored lesson.genderAlternatives string for that turn (or its ё→е fold), or equals the single reviewed word-order variant (or its fold); all entries are complete turns.

Staged-form gate: constructions introduced at B1 (бы, который-forms, ли, чтобы + past, short participles, -ся process verbs, раньше/перестать frames, если … то) may appear in learner turns only from the lesson range that stages them in path.staging; the gate table lives in validator config, not in lesson JSON. A2-inherited constructions (gendered past, future буду + infinitive and perfective future, давайте, можно, comparatives, потому что) are globally licensed in every learner turn, including future closings in dialogue[3].
semanticReviewRules: Turn 2 must add new information or a complication that turn 1 could not have anticipated; captions must not hint at it.
Learner never asserts staff-only decisions (refund approved, room changed) — learner requests, proposes, accepts with modification.
Shape A ends with a workable next step; shape B replies form one connected mini-narrative across turns 1 and 3; shape C turn 3 accepts the counter-offer with one explicit change.
Cloze distractors are grammatical Russian words but produce a wrong aspect, case, connector or meaning; no near-synonym (also acceptable) among choices.
Concession pairs (хотя/зато/однако/впрочем) must contrast real content, not restate it.
Narration aspect reads naturally to a native reviewer: no perfective for ongoing background, no imperfective for a single completed event in sequence.
Gender audit: every speaker-agreeing form in canonical learner lines matches path gender; genderAlternative is a complete, natural sentence, not a swapped suffix.
Register audit: no ты, no diminutives of address, no slang (чё, ваще, короче), no bureaucratic calques (осуществить, являться) in spoken turns.
Trophy whyThisWord explains real reuse value and the form chosen (why nominative/infinitive/adverb).
German and English bases are idiomatic renderings of the same Russian meaning, not of each other.
Cultural plausibility: prices, hours, institutions (МФЦ, поликлиника, пункт выдачи) are realistic for a Russian-speaking city without naming a specific one.
requiredSchemaExtensions: Base shapes are unchanged: dialogue tuple of 4, chunks/terms arrays, cloze array, recall, pattern, trophyWord, German pedagogicalGoal string.

Proposed (optional, no runtime support claimed): lesson.genderAlternatives — optional object keyed '1' and/or '3' whose values are complete reviewed opposite-gender strings of that learner turn, placed as a sibling of dialogue; absent when the turn is gender-free; the validator (not the app) merges them into any accepted-answer set and never generates suffixes.

Speak: no new runtime config or pilot setting; B1 lessons use the existing B1 scaffold (threshold 0.65, 15-second recording). The gendered-choice cloze check and the per-lesson speaker-agreeing token list are validator rules only; no new JSON fields.
Captions: validator quotes dialogue[0].targetText for B1 (no separate interlocutor line field).
Staging gate table is validator configuration keyed by pathNumber and lesson range, derived from path.staging; no stagedConstructions field is added to paths.
ё→е acceptance is hand-listed as in A2 until a loader fold is approved (see unresolvedDecisions).

paths.title: Как это было
paths.anchor: Telling a listener what happened: background, sequence, surprise
paths.register: friends and colleagues on вы, warm, narrative

staging.productive: imperfective past for background/duration with мы or у нас было; sequencers сначала, потом; present-tense frame for setting
staging.recognitionOnly: perfective sequence verbs in the interlocutor's follow-up

staging.productive: perfective event chains with затем, наконец, вдруг; completed-action contrast with imperfective background; genderAlternative for я-forms
staging.recognitionOnly: когда-clauses combining both aspects

staging.productive: когда + imperfective background vs perfective event; пока; однажды frames; time adverbs рано, поздно, случайно
staging.recognitionOnly: past gerund (-в: приехав) in the interlocutor's lines

paths.clozeSchema: form blanks on verb aspect (cue: 'завершённое действие' / 'длительное'), connector blanks on сначала/потом/затем/вдруг/когда; third blank optional choice of time adverb; never a pronoun blank
paths.recycles: A2 past tense (gendered, now mostly мы-based); A2 future (буду + infinitive, perfective future) explicitly licensed in dialogue[3] closings from L1 (e.g. L10 Да, занятия будут продолжаться); feeds P9 L1-3 and P10 L1-3

lessons.beat: Colleague asks about your trip; first flight, then hotel; she asks what you saw.
Friend asks about Sunday; market first, then park; he asks whom you met there.
Neighbour asks about post office queue; you waited long; she asks if parcel arrived.
Host asks about city day; three stops in sequence; she asks which was best.
Friend asks why late; rain started suddenly on walk; she asks where you sheltered.
Colleague asks about flat search; finally found one after months; she asks the district.
Teacher asks for a mistake story; once took wrong train; she asks how you returned.
Friend asks about morning; got up early, café closed; she asks what you did.
Host asks about concert; ended late, metro closed; she asks how you got home.
Friend asks how you met your teacher; by chance in library; she asks if lessons continue.

paths.title: С одной стороны
paths.anchor: Giving an opinion and conceding a point without losing it
paths.register: colleagues, club acquaintances on вы, discursive but friendly

staging.productive: мне кажется, что / я думаю, что; reason with потому что; evaluative adverbs (интересно, дорого, полезно) in impersonal frames
staging.recognitionOnly: по-моему, на мой взгляд in interlocutor lines

staging.productive: concession with хотя and зато; contrast а / но; comparative adjectives already known
staging.recognitionOnly: несмотря на + accusative

staging.productive: однако, впрочем, пожалуй, наоборот as discourse pivots; с одной стороны … с другой стороны
staging.recognitionOnly: всё-таки and всё же as emphatic concessions

paths.clozeSchema: connector blank (хотя/зато/однако/впрочем) with contrast-breaking distractors; form blank on predicate adverb vs adjective (cue 'безличное'); optional choice blank on evaluative word
paths.recycles: A2 потому что and comparatives; P1 narration in examples; feeds P9 L4-6 and P10 L4-6

lessons.beat: Colleague asks if new schedule works; seems fine, mornings hard; she asks why.
Club host asks your opinion of film; good but long; he asks about ending.
Friend doubts evening classes; you see the sense for speaking; he asks about cost.
Coworker asks about winter here; cold though beautiful; she asks whether you still walk.
Friend asks about small flat; tiny but central; he asks about noise.
Barista asks if you taste difference between beans; slight; she asks preference.
Colleague praises new app; you agree, however it crashes; she asks when.
Friend asks about restaurant; pricey, though worth it; he asks what to order.
Host asks whether to extend meeting; perhaps shorter is better; she asks your reason.
Friend assumes you dislike remote work; on the contrary; he asks why.

paths.title: Если бы можно было
paths.anchor: Softened requests and hypotheticals at counters and with landlords
paths.register: service staff and landlords on вы, polite-cautious

staging.productive: вы не могли бы + infinitive; можно было бы + infinitive; у меня просьба
staging.recognitionOnly: хотел бы / хотела бы displayed in both forms in pattern notes

staging.productive: мне бы хотелось + infinitive/accusative; было бы лучше/удобнее + infinitive; вместо + genitive; заранее
staging.recognitionOnly: если бы clauses in interlocutor counter-offers

staging.productive: если бы + past, (то) + бы + past; genderAlternative mandatory where я + past appears; иначе as consequence marker
staging.recognitionOnly: subjunctive wishes (хоть бы) and разрешите in staff lines

paths.clozeSchema: form blank on бы + past (cue 'условное'), connector blank если/иначе/вместо; third blank choice of politeness verb (уточнить/попробовать/разрешить); distractors break бы agreement
paths.recycles: A2 давайте and future offers; P2 concession in acceptance lines; feeds P9 L4-10

lessons.beat: Hotel desk; request to change room; clerk offers higher floor; you accept wanting quiet side.
Bank clerk; could she clarify the fee; she quotes yearly; you ask monthly option.
Gym desk; could you try a trial class; staff offers Thursday; you ask evening slot.
Landlord; possibly repair on Friday; he proposes Saturday; you accept morning only.
Café; you'd like tea instead of coffee in set; waiter checks; you accept with lemon.
Dentist desk; you'd like booking in advance; receptionist offers March; you ask earlier date.
Office; could they allow bike inside; manager offers courtyard; you accept if locked.
Courier; if earlier, otherwise you miss it; he proposes neighbour; you suggest workplace.
Tailor; probably shorter sleeve would suit; she suggests two centimetres; you settle on one.
Shop; if you took two, would discount apply; clerk offers five percent; you ask ten.

paths.title: Тот, который
paths.anchor: Identifying and describing things and people precisely
paths.register: lost-and-found, shops, colleagues on вы, neutral-helpful

staging.productive: который in nominative (сумка, которая; рюкзак, который); colour and size with у + genitive
staging.recognitionOnly: который in oblique cases in staff lines

staging.productive: который in accusative and prepositional (которую, в котором); descriptive instrumental (с ремнём)
staging.recognitionOnly: long passive participle (сделанный, оставленный) as adjective

staging.productive: выглядит как / похоже на; тот самый; relative chains with genitive (у которого); потерять with object
staging.recognitionOnly: active present participle (лежащий, стоящий) in interlocutor descriptions

paths.clozeSchema: form blank on который case (cue 'падеж по роли в придаточном'), choice blank on colour/size/material adjective agreement; optional connector blank (в котором/у которого)
paths.recycles: A2 adjectives and prepositions of place; P1 past for 'where I left it'; feeds P9 descriptions of faulty items

lessons.beat: Lost-and-found asks which bag; the one that has blue strap; she asks what's inside.
Police desk asks for bike description; you give it; officer asks about frame sticker.
Assistant asks which jacket; the dark green colour; she asks your size.

paths.title: Не подскажете
paths.anchor: Asking indirectly at desks where the answer is never simple
paths.register: receptions, info points, HR on вы, formal-polite

staging.productive: скажите, пожалуйста / не подскажете + question-word clause (где, когда, сколько); хотелось бы узнать
staging.recognitionOnly: ли-questions in staff replies

staging.productive: embedded ли-questions (не знаете ли вы, есть ли, можно ли); точно as focus
staging.recognitionOnly: или нет tails

staging.productive: насчёт + genitive; подробнее о + prepositional; chained inquiries with а также / и ещё; conditions and deadlines (условия, срок)
staging.recognitionOnly: reported speech with что (мне сказали, что)

paths.clozeSchema: connector blank on ли placement vs question word; form blank on genitive after насчёт/условия (cue 'родительный'); choice blank on inquiry verb (узнать/уточнить/подсказать)
paths.recycles: A2 где/когда questions and можно; P3 бы in softened inquiries; feeds P9 L1-3 and P6 result checks

lessons.beat: Clinic desk; you want to know when results ready; doctor away; you ask alternative.
Station info; could they say where lost property is; it's closed; you ask hours.
Pool desk; you ask whether schedule changed; summer hours now; you ask weekend.
Pharmacy; whether they know exactly if item in stock; tomorrow only; you reserve.

paths.title: Уже сделано
paths.anchor: Reporting what is done, underway and still pending
paths.register: workshops, offices, neighbours on вы, matter-of-fact

staging.productive: neuter short passive participles as results (сделано, закрыто, открыто) with уже / ещё не; impersonal frames (всё готово-type)
staging.recognitionOnly: -ся process verbs in staff replies

staging.productive: -ся process verbs (ремонтируется, проверяется, оформляется); нужно/надо + infinitive; занято/свободно
staging.recognitionOnly: instrumental agent (мастером)

staging.productive: participle agreeing with noun (заказ оформлен, заявка получена — agreement with thing, not speaker); результат with получен/готов; доставка назначена
staging.recognitionOnly: long participles (оформленный заказ) and будет сделано

paths.clozeSchema: form blank on short participle agreement with noun (cue 'род существительного'), connector blank уже/ещё не/пока; choice blank on process verb -ся; distractors use wrong voice or aspect
paths.recycles: A2 готово/заплачено phrases; P5 inquiry frames for checking status; feeds P9 L1-6 problem statements

paths.title: Чтобы успеть
paths.anchor: Purposes, plans and conditions while agreeing on details
paths.register: teachers, trainers, HR, friends on вы, planning tone

staging.productive: чтобы + infinitive (same subject); цель with чтобы; успеть + infinitive; собираюсь + infinitive
staging.recognitionOnly: для того чтобы

staging.productive: если …, то …; planning with планирую / собираюсь; подготовить by deadline (к + dative); вовремя
staging.recognitionOnly: чтобы + past clause in interlocutor lines

staging.productive: чтобы + past with different subject (чтобы коллеги понимали); если не …, (то) …; обязательно; отпуск/курс planning vocabulary
staging.recognitionOnly: в случае если; при условии что

paths.clozeSchema: form blank on чтобы + infinitive vs past (cue 'один субъект / разные субъекты'), connector blank если/то/чтобы; choice blank on plan verb (собираюсь/успею/подготовлю)

staging.recognitionOnly: бывало in interlocutor lines

staging.productive: редко/иногда; привычка + infinitive; больше не + present; всё ещё
staging.recognitionOnly: перестать/начать + imperfective in questions

staging.productive: перестать/начать + imperfective infinitive; детство frames (в детстве мы); стало/изменилось + comparative (neuter, gender-free); с тех пор
staging.recognitionOnly: привык/привыкла (both forms shown, never required)

paths.clozeSchema: form blank on imperfective past vs present (cue 'раньше / сейчас'), connector blank а/но/с тех пор; choice blank on frequency adverb; no gendered answer — blanks fall on adverbs, мы-forms or present verbs
paths.recycles: P1 narration aspects; P2 contrast connectors; feeds P10 L1-6

paths.title: Это не то
paths.anchor: Complaining calmly and reaching a resolution (capstone)
paths.register: service staff, landlords, airline on вы, firm but polite

staging.recognitionOnly: по гарантии, в течение + genitive

staging.recognitionOnly: formal written-complaint register in staff lines

paths.title: Мой год
paths.anchor: Telling the story of a year and what comes next (capstone)
paths.register: friends, teacher, mentor on вы, reflective-warm

staging.productive: year narration recycling P1 aspects and P8 раньше/сейчас (male canonical, full female alternatives); событие/переезд frames
staging.recognitionOnly: в прошлом году / в этом году variants

staging.productive: evaluation recycling P2 concession (хотя/зато) and P2 opinion frames; lexical items впечатление, достижение, итог; благодаря as a lexical preposition with the A2 dative (благодаря клубу) — no new grammar family
staging.recognitionOnly: самое главное, что

staging.productive: plans recycling P7 and P3: мечта + infinitive, в будущем, впереди, если …, то …, собираюсь продолжать
staging.recognitionOnly: надеюсь, что in interlocutor lines

paths.clozeSchema: form blank on aspect in narration or чтобы clause (cue given), connector blank благодаря/хотя/если; choice blank on time frame (в прошлом/в этом/в следующем); no gendered answers
paths.recycles: P1 narration, P2 opinion, P3 wishes, P7 plans, P8 then/now
